✨ Unbox a little jar of happiness with the Premium Mystery Jewellery Jar by Morchadi Jewels! 🫙🤍
Love surprises, trendy jewellery and vintage accessories? Our Premium Mystery Jar is carefully packed with a beautiful mix of vintage, anti-tarnish and Korean-inspired jewellery pieces, making every unboxing a fun little surprise.
🎁 What's Inside Every Premium Mystery Jar?
Each jar contains 10–12 jewellery & accessory items, including:
- ⌚ 1 Vintage Watch – Confirmed in Every Jar
- ✨ 3–4 Anti-Tarnish Jewellery Products
- 🌸 6–7 Korean Jewellery Items
- 💎 A curated mix of trendy, cute & statement styles
Every jar is different, so the exact designs and styles remain a mystery until you open it! 💌
🤍 Why You'll Love It
✔️ 10–12 surprise jewellery items in every jar
✔️ 1 vintage watch guaranteed
✔️ Anti-tarnish jewellery included
✔️ Trendy Korean-inspired jewellery styles
✔️ Perfect for jewellery lovers & collectors
✔️ Aesthetic premium gift-ready packaging
✔️ Amazing surprise value at just ₹1,199
Whether you're treating yourself or looking for a unique birthday, anniversary, friendship or surprise gift, this mystery jar is made to turn an ordinary unboxing into an exciting experience. 🎀
One little jar. 10–12 surprises. A whole lot of sparkle. ✨
Designs, colours and jewellery styles may vary from the images shown. Every jar is curated individually, so the contents will be a surprise.
Please Note : Cash on delivery is not available for this Product
